mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: seeing nerves and blood routes reach the same muscles helped connect the separate systems.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive and urinary organs was clear, but the named slots made those steps fairly predictable.

surprise.text: The chest and lower body join with the diaphragm between them, while nerves, blood vessels and the food pipe cross by their own routes. That made their layout clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though attaching the lymph network relied mostly on the chapter's named instruction; the result clarified its connection to the neck vein.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems work together. This ending ties the parts together, though much of the fitting was predictable.
